source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
A charging unit can pick as [charge targets](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) only units no further away than the maximum distance its [charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) allows once every modifier applies, including modifiers to the move's maximum distance, such as [taking to the skies](vsdata:core-rule/flying-models). If a modifier comes after you pick a charge target and puts that target out of reach, the unit must pick new targets (see 04.03.03).

For example:

- a unit rolls 7" for its charge and has a datasheet ability that gives +1 to its charge rolls: its maximum distance becomes 8", letting it pick targets within 8"
- a **FLYING** unit that takes to the skies rolls 9" for its charge: its maximum distance becomes 7", that is 9" less the 2" for taking to the skies, letting it pick targets within 7"
